story.text: Argentina and France drew 3-3 in the Final of the FIFA World Cup 2022. Argentina won 4-2 on penalties after extra time. Argentina had more of the ball (55 percent to 45 percent), and Argentina also created the better chances by expected goals, or xG, a measure of chance quality (3.10 to 2.18). The goals came from Lionel Messi at 22:24 (penalty), Ángel Di María at 35:22, Kylian Mbappé at 79:24 (penalty), Kylian Mbappé at 80:59, Lionel Messi at 107:58 and Kylian Mbappé at 117:05 (penalty).
